data.one_liner: An authorization library supporting access control models like ACL, RBAC, and ABAC.
data.what_it_does: Casbin is an authorization library that enforces access control policies using models based on the PERM metamodel (Policy, Effect, Request, Matchers). It manages role-user mappings, role hierarchies, and evaluates access requests against configured rules.
use_when: You need flexible access control models like ACL, RBAC, or ABAC in your Dart or Flutter application
You want to manage permissions via configuration files or at runtime using standard APIs
avoid_when: You need user authentication (verifying usernames and passwords)
You need a password container or user management database
strengths: Supports multiple access control models (ACL, RBAC, ABAC, RESTful, etc.)
Allows switching authorization mechanisms simply by modifying configuration files
Provides both primitive management APIs and friendly RBAC APIs
weaknesses: Does not handle authentication or user login management
Requires managing users and roles externally or via provided mapping APIs
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and initialize the Enforcer with a model file and a policy file.
